hotels.title: Greek Island Glamour: All-Inclusive Rhodes Retreat with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Sitting directly on Kolymbia Beach with crystal-clear Aegean waters at the door, Paralos Rodos Lifestyle lives up to its name - the Greek for 'by the sea'. Complimentary sun loungers and shaded gazebos line both the beach and poolside, with swim-up pool access and panoramic sea views setting the tone. The restaurant's daily Mediterranean buffet draws on fresh local ingredients, while Pithos serves refined Greek a la carte cuisine. As the sun dips, the Lobby Bar's veranda becomes the resort's natural heartbeat - cocktails flowing, the Aegean glowing. Set on Rhodes’ north-west coast, this all-inclusive retreat is a short drive from Rhodes Old Town’s medieval walls and the Palace of the Grand Master, with both Lindos' clifftop Acropolis and the Valley of the Butterflies a day-trip away.
